description: Create the brief for ONE roadmap item (the Plan tab's "Create brief" button). Idempotent: if the item already has a brief it returns outcome "exists" with that briefId. If the item's last brief FAILED (brief.status "failed", brief.error says why), calling this again retries it (outcome "started"). For a normal item this drafts a new-article brief. For a type="refresh" item it drafts a REFRESH brief for the existing page (kind="refresh", with a proposed changes[] edit plan). Returns {briefId, operationId, outcome: "started" | "exists"}. When started, poll get_job(operationId) until completed, then read it with seo_get_brief and (optionally) refine it with seo_edit_brief. Nothing is written or rewritten until the brief is approved with seo_approve_briefs. Approving a refresh brief overwrites the existing article in place - confirm with the user first. Find items with seo_list_roadmap (brief.status "none" = no brief yet).
name: seo_roadmap_create_brief
